text:
maria-g: Heads-up: rolled a small canary for the kv-dedup optimization. Early results: median latency down ~17% on short interactive sessions, token compute per-request down ~10% on our tracebench mix. No measurable p99 regressions so far.
ajohnson: Solid. Any change to cache hit or eviction behavior?
maria-g: cache_hit_rate +2.8pp, eviction_rate -12% on the canary shards. Fewer duplicate KV allocations means fewer microbatch flushes which helps p50.
slee: Is this enabled by default? impact on Dedicated?
maria-g: Default is off; canary enabled on 6% of hosted pods. Toggle flag: runtime.features.kv_dedup = true. We'll only enable on Dedicated with customer opt-in after validation.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary roll r-2026-09-kv-dedup created. targets: hosted-eu, hosted-us-west, 6% pods. start: 2026-09-08T10:12Z. Monitor: https://console.redwood.ai/rollouts/r-2026-09-kv-dedup
perf-bot: perf-bot: 6h automated summary: p50 -17.1%, p90 -5.9%, p99 +0.1% (within noise). Estimated cost savings per 1M tokens: -10.3%.
ajohnson: p99 noise ok. Any memory/regressions on small GPUs?
maria-g: peak GPU working set lowered ~4% on average; no OOMs observed in canary. Cold-start latency unchanged.
tanya: Please add a blurb for the customer-facing changelog and a note in the support playbook about Dedicated opt-in process.
maria-g: Will add to weekly digest and runtime changelog. Draft docs: https://internal.redwood.ai/docs/runtime/kv-dedup (WIP)
slee: What tests do we run before Dedicated opt-in?
maria-g: We run a 10k request compatibility sweep across common models, p99 guardrails (<+1%), memory and cold-start checks, and a short A/B on customer traffic if they allow it. Ops checklist: monitor p50, p99, cache_hit_rate, eviction_rate, microbatch_flush_count for 48h.
ops-bot: ops-bot: Dashboard tile created: Runtime / KV Dedup Canary -> https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/kv-dedup-canary
maria-g: TL;DR: meaningful median latency and cost win, safe p99 profile so far, canary live on hosted 6%, Dedicated requires opt-in. Ping me for anomalies. :rocket: :eyes:
